improvements: The four natural-draught cooling towers are waisted concrete shells 50 m tall with a darker rim, at their mapped centres and radii (15.9–17.2 m); they were drawn as round apartment blocks with windows.
Seven 50 m steel stacks and the low concrete weir across the Dambovita were added from their OSM ways.
remainingGaps: The hyperboloid profile is a model estimate (seven rings); shell thickness, the open base lattice and any markings are not modelled. Stack radius (2.4 m at the base) follows the source comment.
These studies are centred on the four towers: three stacks and the weir (up to 450 m from the anchor) are outside the frames.
District-only scenery in Grozavesti; no in-world capture from Sos. Grozavesti or the quays was made for this record.
